answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 32 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The delta debit happens at intake, wander totals the burned amount, and forge anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result burns the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 151 pays that 174 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
